retrievalProfile.description: A dynamic multi-frame layout resembling a tilted film strip or contact sheet with a clean white border and stacked vertical typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A series of three rectangular photographic frames arranged vertically with a slight clockwise tilt, mimicking a cut strip of film. The frames are separated by thick black borders and set against a stark white background, with text tucked into the upper right negative space.
coreVisualRelationships: Sequential frames showing different moments of the same subject
Diagonal alignment of frames against a static white canvas
Typography aligned to the tilt of the top frame
Consistent lighting and color palette across all internal images
coreInvariants: Uniform tilt angle for all frames
Subject interaction with a central prop (guitar)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered within each frame, appearing at a medium-shot scale showing head, shoulders, and instrument.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central frame is the largest and most complete, serving as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal descent from the top left to the bottom right, guided by the tilt of the frames.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space on the right side provides room for typographic elements and balances the heavy black frames.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Blue and Sunburst Yellow (Subject's clothing and instrument)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark interior of the frames and the bright white exterior; moderate saturation within the photos.

characterSpecificRedesigns: First letter of each word highlighted in a different color (red/blue)
Horizontal green bars underlining specific words
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with color-coding for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, compact geometric feel of the original.
Provides the clean, mid-century modern look required for 80s editorial style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate three sequential portraits of a musician with a guitar, styled in 80s fashion, placed inside three black-bordered rectangular frames. Tilt the entire three-frame sequence 5 degrees clockwise on a solid white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add four lines of vertically stacked uppercase sans-serif text in the top right corner, tilted to match the frames. Use blue for most letters, red for the first letter of the bottom two lines, and add thin green horizontal lines between the words.

verificationChecks: Black borders are thick and distinct

adjustableVariables: Number of frames in the sequence
Color of the initial caps in the text
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the tilt is consistent across all frames and text.
Ensure the white background is free of artifacts.
Verify that the text does not overlap the image frames.
Confirm the black borders are uniform in width.
recipe.reuseFormula: Three-frame tilted montage + thick black borders + high-key white background + stacked color-coded sans-serif typography.
